name: Usage stats
author: iMacroPad community
blurb: Your own pad in numbers, on any layout or the screensaver: screen time today, the week as a chart, the layouts, Mac apps and themes you use most, and the keys you press most. Read from Settings ▸ Stats on this iPad; nothing leaves it.
